subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Which WebChat recovery presentation should be supported when unseen messages arrive while the user is scrolled up?
rationale: Current main intentionally preserves the New messages action across auto-scroll modes, so hiding or replacing it requires UX and accessibility intent rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Persisted UI Mode
options.body: Add a browser-local preference for standard, compact or dismissible, and hidden presentation while preserving a keyboard-accessible catch-up action.

options.title: Keep Current Action
options.body: Retain the mandatory New messages action as the supported recovery affordance and decline an additional setting.

options.title: Gateway Configuration
options.body: Add a `gateway.webchat` option, accepting a broader server configuration and upgrade surface for this presentation choice.

recommendation.title: Persisted UI Mode
recommendation.body: Add a browser-local preference for standard, compact or dismissible, and hidden presentation while preserving a keyboard-accessible catch-up action.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged auto-scroll settings work owns the adjacent persisted WebChat preference and explicitly retained the recovery action.
